global_events: Twenty-one current official Auction House records screened in three independent source groups; eighteen selected and three fail-closed.
Eighteen official source upgrades retained: four full direct-page readbacks and fourteen current indexed official lot-page snapshots.
Only future 10–25 August 2026 selected records retained.
One record with a publisher weekday/date conflict was excluded rather than reconciled by inference.
Records lacking sufficient readable accommodation, tenure or occupation fields remained excluded.
Six representative repository searches returned zero hits; exhaustive duplicate proof is not claimed.
Guide prices are auction indications, not valuations or achieved prices.
Publisher rents and potential-income wording were not independently underwritten.
Title, lease, charges, tenancy and occupation remain legal-pack dependent.
HMO, conversion, reconfiguration and value-add wording was not converted into guaranteed outcomes.
Refurbishment and condition wording requires professional inspection.
Indexed official lot-page snapshots are explicitly distinguished from full direct-page readbacks.
Buyer fees, deposits and legal-pack disbursements remain publisher/legal-pack dependent.
No second runner, owner or task created; continuation key preserved.
Wave, progress, web, report and validation files require canonical publication and readback.
Automation 167 port-8012 DOM proof remains external and unresolved.
Manual action remains OPEN until verified DOM proof exists.
Parcel, geometry and final promotion remain blocked; no synthetic evidence created.
Research may continue under the existing single canonical task while external DOM proof remains absent.
Research was split into three bounded groups and repository writes remain serial to avoid publisher contention.
